goal: Overlap block reading and deserialization with validation to avoid waiting on disk I/O
Substantially speeds up initial block download and chainstate reindexing for node operators
agreement: Verified by testing speedups on IBD and reindex-chainstate (andrewtoth)
Unaddressed objection: prefetched blocks on invalid branches remain in memory indefinitely (w0xlt)
Resolved objection: thread start and exit debug log spam fixed by keeping thread pool alive (fanquake)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because background prefetching yields substantial performance gains for IBD and chain reindexing
Benchmark results demonstrate over 1.5x speedups for reindexing and 1.13x for initial block download
